properties.name: management.health.cosid.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the CosId machine slot health check.

properties.name: cosid.mybatis.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the MyBatis interceptor that fills @CosId ids before an INSERT.

properties.name: cosid.mybatis.list-key
properties.description: The parameter name of a batch insert's entities.

properties.name: cosid.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the Spring Data JDBC callback that fills @CosId and @Id ids before an insert. Off by default, as in 4.x: an @Id the database generates must not be filled.

properties.name: cosid.jdbc.id-generator
properties.description: The generator of Spring Data JDBC @Id properties without @CosId.

properties.name: cosid.activiti.enabled
properties.description: Whether Activiti's ids come from a CosId generator.

properties.name: cosid.activiti.generator-name
properties.description: The generator of Activiti's ids. Unset, the cosid.activiti system property's, else default.

properties.name: cosid.flowable.enabled
properties.description: Whether Flowable's ids come from a CosId generator.

properties.name: cosid.flowable.generator-name
properties.description: The generator of Flowable's ids. Unset, the cosid.flowable system property's, else default.

properties.name: cosid.axon.generator-name
properties.description: The generator of Axon's identifiers. Unset, the cosid.axon system property's, else default.
